long_biography.plain_text:
Meridian Capital became the investment platform through which Yevgeniy Feld applied experience gained in Kazakhstan's banking and industrial sectors. Trained as an economist, he served as a managing director at Kazkommertsbank, where his work included restructuring enterprises moving from state ownership. He and Askar Alshinbayev founded Meridian in 2002 and later held equal 50% interests in the firm.

Feld combined capital allocation with direct project oversight. He helped transform an abandoned property site into a major shopping centre later sold to an institutional property fund. In 2004 he also co-founded an airport platform and oversaw its expansion before Meridian exited the investment. The platform became one of Russia's largest regional airport operators before Meridian sold its interest.
